description: This file defines an abstract class 'DocumentBusinessEvent' which extends 'AbstractBusinessEvent' with 'Document' as its generic parameter. It encapsulates common behavior for document-related business events within the Apache Fineract infrastructure, setting a category label and providing the primary key of the associated document.

classes.name: DocumentBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing business events related to documents, providing category labeling and access to the document's ID.

methods.name: DocumentBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific Document instance.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the fixed category string 'Document' for all instances.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key ID of the associated Document.
